hdmi_in.description: The HDMI-in jack: Digilent's dvi2rgb decoding the cable to parallel video, the hot-plug and DDC lines, and the pins they land on. Every design on this board that receives bayerlink uses this block rather than restating any of it. kClkRange 1: the board's own base overlay runs this exact 74.25 MHz mode with range 1 -- the IP comment's bucket arithmetic says 2, and empirically range 2 locks the clock but never aligns the data. Trust the design that demonstrably receives.

frontend.description: The front end, as bayerlink-fpga names it: the facts the receiver is generated from (the byte-lane map) follow from it.

max_link_khz.description: The link clock this jack is constrained for (hdmi_in.xdc states it as a period): the fastest legal link, as the board's base overlay does. A link mode advertised in the EDID is checked against it.

inputs.name: refclk
inputs.description: 200 MHz, for the front end's delay calibration.

inputs.name: sda_pull
inputs.description: The DDC slave pulling SDA low.

outputs.name: pclk
outputs.description: The clock recovered from the link: it stops when the cable is pulled.
